### Technical Deep Dive

```
🔧 Technical Deep Dive: Building a Fast Document Search

When building OpenClaw Doc Viewer, we faced a challenge: how to search 1000+ Markdown documents in under 100ms?

Solution: FlexSearch + smart indexing

Key decisions:
1. Client-side search (no server load)
2. Incremental indexing (fast updates)
3. Type-safe implementation (TypeScript)

Result: <100ms search for 1000+ docs

Read the full technical blog: [link]

#engineering #performance #javascript #techblog
```
